title: SETSUM: Summarization and Visualization of Student Evaluations of Teaching

bias_targets.methodology: Conducted human evaluation surveys asking university instructors to rate whether the proposed visualization and summarization system helps them interpret student evaluation results with less bias (e.g., negativity bias) compared to standard static PDF reports.

Measured a 'Sentiment Difference' metric during unsupervised extractive summarization to ensure the algorithm extracts sentences that accurately reflect the balanced sentiment distribution of the underlying comments, rather than disproportionately selecting the more common positive sentences.
